notes: DiscoFlate v3.56.2 — the Go Live intro dropdown was built before the page had decided which scene was current, so it came up empty or half-filled no matter how many groups you had. It now waits for that, and lists EVERY scene's groups labelled by scene rather than only the Chat-linked one. If no scene is linked to Chat, an intro group still plays — the server finds whichever scene owns it instead of quietly doing nothing.
